attempts.answer:
<thought>The team uses Gholdengo as a bulky Nasty Plot win condition, Dragonite and Gyarados as Multiscale/Intimidate-backed Dragon Dance sweepers, Swords Dance Garchomp as a fast physical breaker, and bulky Rotom-Wash and Bulk Up Annihilape providing defensive glue and a second win condition. Items are spread to cover each role: Leftovers for Gholdengo's longevity, Lum Berry for Dragonite's sweep insurance, Yache for Garchomp against Ice Shard, Sitrus for Rotom's pivoting, and Chesto for Annihilape's Rest, with Gyarados Mega Evolving for Mold Breaker-adjacent bulk and power.</thought>

attempts.reasoning:
Build sets quickly. EVs max 32/stat, 66 total.

Gholdengo: Nasty Plot, Shadow Ball, Make It Rain, Recover; Leftovers; Timid 32 HP/32 SpA/2 Spe? Better: 32 HP / 32 SpA / 2 Spe Modest... speed matters; do 32 SpA / 32 Spe Timid, 2 HP.

Dragonite: Multiscale, DD, Dragon Claw/Outrage, Earthquake, Extreme Speed; Lum Berry; 32 Atk/32 Spe Jolly, 2 HP.

Garchomp: Swords Dance, Earthquake, Dragon Claw, Stone Edge/Scale Shot; Rough Skin; Yache Berry; 32 Atk/32 Spe Jolly.

Rotom-Wash: Volt Switch, Hydro Pump, Will-O-Wisp, Protect/Pain Split; Sitrus Berry; 32 HP/32 Def Bold, 2 SpA.

Annihilape: Bulk Up, Drain Punch, Rage Fist, Rest/Taunt; Chesto Berry; 32 HP/32 Def Careful? Careful lowers SpA fine. 32 HP/32 SpD Careful, 2 Atk.

Gyarados: Gyaradosite, Intimidate, DD, Waterfall, Bounce/Earthquake, Crunch/Protect; 32 Atk/32 Spe Jolly, 2 HP.
